quizName:
Sign Test
									  					
									  														  					Check how well you know road signs.

questions.question: What should you do at a school crossing sign?

options.text: Always stop, even if there is no stop sign.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always honk your horn when you see children.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: A five-sided sign means a school zone is near. When you see this sign, stay alert and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does a pennant-shaped sign mean?

options.text: Right turn is allowed on red.

questions.explanation: A pennant-shaped sign marks where passing is not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that right turns are not allowed. You must follow this law where the sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn left. It is unsafe and illegal to make a left turn where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this yellow sign?

options.text: Stop at the crosswalk until a crossing guard signals you to go.
Be ready to stop if children are crossing.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be ready to stop if children are crossing.
questions.explanation: A five-sided sign means you are near a school. Be alert and stop if children are in the crosswalk.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn. You cannot turn around to go the opposite direction where this sign is posted.

questions.question: You see this sign at a railroad crossing with no signal. What should you do?

options.text: Keep going at the same speed while looking and listening for trains.
Slow down, look both ways, listen for trains, and be ready to stop if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, look both ways, listen for trains, and be ready to stop if needed.
questions.explanation: At a railroad crossing with this sign, slow down and look both ways. Listen for trains and be ready to stop. Never try to beat an oncoming train.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are near the end of a divided highway.
You are near the start of a divided highway.
The road ahead will be slippery.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are near the start of a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a divided highway is starting ahead. Stay to the right of the center divider.

questions.question: What does this warning sign tell you about?

options.text: A curve in the road ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A curve in the road ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They alert you to dangers right ahead. This sign warns you about an upcoming right curve.

questions.question: What does this sign mean when shown on the back of a vehicle?

options.text: The vehicle is pulled by an animal.
The vehicle travels at 25 mph or slower.

questions.correctAnswerText: The vehicle travels at 25 mph or slower.
questions.explanation: You may see this sign on slow-moving vehicles like bicycles, horse-drawn carts, or farm vehicles. This sign warns other drivers that the vehicle will travel at 25 mph or slower.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed on vehicles that move slowly.

questions.question: This sign warns you that:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a flag person is ahead. Always follow their directions. Flaggers wear orange or yellow vests, yellow-green shirts, or bright jackets. They use paddles and red flags to direct traffic through work zones and allow workers or construction vehicles to cross.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for vehicles entering from the side.

questions.explanation: This sign tells traffic to stay to the right of an island or barrier. The road ahead is divided into separate directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign means a steep hill is ahead. Slow down and be ready to shift to a lower gear. This protects your brakes from damage.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: An eight-sided red sign means you must stop.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?

options.text: No turns are allowed on the road.
There is a series of curves ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a series of curves ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to conditions coming up. This sign warns drivers about a winding road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to upcoming conditions. This sign warns of an intersection ahead so you can prepare for traffic or prepare to turn.

questions.question: A five-sided sign is a:

options.text: School zone or school crossing sign.

questions.correctAnswerText: School zone or school crossing sign.
questions.explanation: A five-sided sign alerts drivers to a school zone. Some of these signs mark crosswalks in school zones where children or pedestrians may be present.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for people crossing your path.

questions.explanation: This orange warning sign tells you that roadwork is coming up. Stay alert for temporary traffic control devices in work zones.

questions.question: What does this yellow sign mean?

options.text: There is a sharp turn to the right.
A right turn is permitted on a green arrow only.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a sharp turn to the right.
questions.explanation: Some warning signs have a bright yellow-green background. These signs warn of upcoming conditions, including roads with curves and sharp turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They warn you about hazards ahead. This sign tells you the road may be slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A downgrade or steep hill is ahead.
The road will become narrower ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A downgrade or steep hill is ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep hill or downgrade is coming. The hill may be long, steep, or have sharp curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A round sign always means a railroad crossing is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped signs warn of hazards. Orange color is used for construction and maintenance areas.

questions.question: What does this sign warn drivers about?

options.text: The right lane is ending. Merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane is ending. Merge left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you that the right lane will end and you need to move left.

questions.question: If you see a sign above your lane with an arrow and the word "only", what should you do?

options.text: Go in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Go in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This is a lane control sign. It tells you that you must move in the direction shown by the arrow.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to situations you might not see right away. This sign warns you that a side road will cross ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Cars in the right lane must slow down.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that traffic may merge from the right. Be ready to let traffic merge safely.

questions.question: What message appears on a red octagon-shaped sign?
questions.explanation: An octagon (eight-sided) sign always means "stop." You must come to a complete stop at this sign.

questions.question: What does this white sign tell you?

options.text: You may turn left only with a green arrow.
You may turn left on a green light when it is safe.
You must wait for a solid green light to turn left.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may turn left on a green light when it is safe.
questions.explanation: A "yield" sign means you must slow down and be ready to stop. Let any vehicles, bicyclists, or pedestrians pass first. Then you can go.

questions.question: From top to bottom, what is the correct order for traffic lights?
questions.explanation: Traffic lights are ordered from top to bottom as red, yellow, and green. Red is always on top, yellow in the middle, and green on the bottom.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars on the right move first.
Let cross traffic pass before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let cross traffic pass before proceeding.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means you must let other vehicles and pedestrians pass first. Slow down and stop if needed before you go ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign indicate?
questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black markings warn drivers about hazards ahead. Round signs warn only about railroad crossings ahead.

questions.question: What type of condition does this sign warn about?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert drivers to conditions ahead. This sign warns that another road crosses the highway ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to stop.
You must come to a complete stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: A stop sign is the only eight-sided sign on the road. You must come to a complete stop and wait until it is safe before you proceed through the intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you about the road ahead?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road has a reverse curve. The road curves to the right, then to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert drivers to conditions ahead. This sign warns that the right lane is ending and traffic may merge.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may proceed if the way is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a one-way road or entrance. If you see this sign, traffic is coming toward you. Do not enter. Turn around if you are driving toward this sign.

questions.question: What does this yellow sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead has many curves.
There is a sharp curve in the road ahead.
The road ahead may be slippery.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead may be slippery.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead may be slippery when wet.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign shows that a divided highway is starting. You should keep to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.

questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right at this intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that wet roads are slippery and dangerous. Slow down on wet pavement because it takes longer to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Last turn before a toll road.

questions.explanation: Orange signs warn of work zones. A flagger is ahead. Follow the flagger's directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves left then right.
The road ahead curves right then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right then left.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you the road will curve right, then curve left. Slow down to drive safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a stop sign is coming up.

questions.question: This shape and color is a ____ sign.
questions.explanation: A downward-pointing triangle means yield. Slow down and stop if needed. Stop at a marked line if one exists.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right at this intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and yield to traffic on the main road when merging.
Always come to a complete stop.
Activate your turn signal and proceed into traffic at the usual speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield to traffic on the main road when merging.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means slow down and let other traffic pass first. You do not have to stop if no traffic is coming, but always slow down.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and do not use your brakes.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when wet. Slow down.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers they cannot make a U-turn.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An octagonal sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop at the marked stop line. Then proceed only when it is safe.

questions.question: What should you do when you see a flashing yellow light at an intersection?

options.text: Slow down and proceed with caution.
Come to a complete stop as quickly as possible.
Stop and proceed only when the intersection is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and proceed with caution.
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means slow down and proceed with caution. You do not need to come to a complete stop.

questions.question: When you see this sign, what should you do?

options.text: You are approaching a railroad crossing. Be ready to stop.
You will always stop at the upcoming railroad crossing.
Stop and wait for a signal before crossing the railroad tracks.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are approaching a railroad crossing. Be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a railroad crossing is ahead. Look, listen, slow down, and be ready to stop. Wait for any trains to pass before you cross.

questions.question: What does an orange and red triangular sign on a vehicle always mean?
questions.explanation: Slow-moving vehicles like farm tractors and road maintenance vehicles display an orange and red triangle on the back.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrians are walking along the road ahead.

questions.explanation: This yellow sign tells drivers where pedestrians may cross. If a pedestrian is in the crosswalk, you must stop and stay stopped until they are no longer there.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells drivers to watch for pedestrians who may be crossing.

questions.question: What does this yellow sign mean?

options.text: Be prepared to stop if the light is flashing.
There is a traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: This yellow sign shows a traffic signal ahead. Be ready to respond to the upcoming traffic signal.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must travel through the intersection at the posted speed limit.
The maximum speed limit under ideal conditions is 55 mph.
You must not travel below the speed indicated.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum speed limit under ideal conditions is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the maximum speed limit for that road. You can drive slower based on road conditions, but you cannot drive faster than the posted limit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a 35 mph speed zone after the curve ahead.
Drive no slower than 35 mph around the upcoming curve.
Approach the upcoming curve at 35 mph or slower.

questions.correctAnswerText: Approach the upcoming curve at 35 mph or slower.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you to an upcoming curve. The speed shown is the recommended safe speed for that curve.

questions.question: What type of sign is this?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about hazards ahead. You might see changes in traffic direction, steep grades, or other dangerous situations that need your attention.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign says you cannot turn in the direction shown by the arrow. In this case, you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that you are leaving a one-way highway. You will soon drive on a two-way highway with traffic moving in both directions.

questions.question: What is this bicyclist signaling?
questions.explanation: Bicycles do not have turn signals. Bicyclists use hand and arm signals instead. When a bicyclist holds their left arm straight out, they are signaling a left turn.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right
The road ahead turns sharply right then sharply left

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right then sharply left
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you the road will turn sharply to the right and then sharply to the left.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You cannot travel in this direction

questions.correctAnswerText: You cannot travel in this direction
questions.explanation: Red signs tell drivers what actions are not allowed. If you see this sign, you are going the wrong way. Turn around immediately.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No left turn is allowed here
You can turn left only after stopping
All traffic must turn right at the next intersection

questions.correctAnswerText: No left turn is allowed here
questions.explanation: A red circle with a line through it means the action is not allowed. This sign means left turns are prohibited.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a crossroad is ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead has a series of turns and curves

questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert you to hazards. This sign warns you to drive carefully in wet conditions because the road will be slippery and harder to control.

questions.question: What does an orange-colored sign like this mean?
questions.explanation: Orange signs warn of construction areas. Drive carefully through these areas.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Drive only in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive only in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers the direction they must drive. You must follow the arrow.

questions.question: What does this yellow warning sign mean?

options.text: You are approaching a school or school crosswalk.
Slow down, drive with caution, and watch for children.

questions.explanation: This sign is placed on roads near schools. It warns you to slow down, be careful, and look for children.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows you are near or entering a school zone. Watch for children and follow the speed limit.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and yield to trains.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield to trains.
questions.explanation: This round sign means a railroad crossing is ahead. Slow down, look, listen, and be ready to stop for trains.

questions.question: When you see this sign, you should stop and:

options.text: Check for vehicles only in the direction that you plan on going, then proceed.
Let all vehicles that arrive before or after you go first.
Check for traffic in all directions before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check for traffic in all directions before proceeding.
questions.explanation: At a stop sign, come to a complete stop. Look in all directions before you go.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means the right lane is ending soon. Drivers in that lane will need to merge.

questions.question: When you see this sign, you should:

options.text: Watch for traffic merging from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for traffic merging from the right.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that traffic may merge into your lane from the right. Stay alert.

questions.question: If you approach a flashing red traffic light, you:

options.text: Are traveling in the wrong direction.
Must treat the intersection as if it is controlled by a stop sign.
May not proceed until it changes to green.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must treat the intersection as if it is controlled by a stop sign.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light means stop. Come to a complete stop and yield to all other traffic and pedestrians before going.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red and white triangle sign means you must yield the right-of-way to other vehicles.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts drivers that bicycles may cross the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this white sign mean?

options.text: The railroad crossing is controlled. Keep your regular speed.
Look, listen, and be ready to stop if needed.
Stop at the railroad tracks and wait for a signal before crossing.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look, listen, and be ready to stop if needed.
questions.explanation: At a railroad crossing, you must look, listen, slow down, and be ready to stop. Wait for any trains to pass before you go.

questions.question: What is this symbol used for?
questions.explanation: A reflective orange triangle on the back of a vehicle means it moves slowly. You may see this on farm equipment, roadwork vehicles, or horse-drawn wagons. It is orange during the day and appears as a hollow red triangle at night.

questions.question: This white sign means you should not pass other vehicles:

options.text: Until after you pass the sign.
Unless it seems safe to do so.

questions.explanation: A white rectangular sign tells you to follow the rule shown. This sign means you cannot pass other vehicles at all.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows there is a crosswalk. Watch for people crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows there is a pedestrian crosswalk.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a yield sign is coming. Start to slow down when you see this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You can travel in either direction in this lane.
Traffic is moving in both directions.
You are approaching a divided highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is moving in both directions.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you of two-way traffic.

questions.question: What type of sign is this?
questions.explanation: A triangle pointing downward is always a yield sign. Be ready to slow down or stop when you see it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means a divided highway is starting ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You can only drive straight ahead.
A divided highway is coming up.
You can turn left or drive straight.

questions.correctAnswerText: You can turn left or drive straight.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that your lane splits into two directions. You can turn left or drive straight ahead in a lane with this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic light is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must turn either right or left.
A four-way intersection is coming up.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must turn either right or left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that the road splits ahead and you must go either right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows that a side road intersection is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Parking reserved for people with disabilities.

questions.correctAnswerText: Parking reserved for people with disabilities.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces for vehicles with disability license plates, disabled veteran plates, or disability placards.

questions.question: What should you do at this red and white sign?

options.text: Stop and check for traffic from both directions before going.
Let traffic on the road you want to enter or cross go first.
Keep steady speed and check for traffic from all directions.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let traffic on the road you want to enter or cross go first.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means you must slow down and be ready to stop if needed. You must let any vehicles, bicycles, or pedestrians pass before you go. You do not have the right-of-way.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road is turning or getting narrower.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is turning or getting narrower.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is turning sharply or narrowing. You may see several of these signs on sharp curves or before narrow bridges.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A steep downhill grade is ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A steep downhill grade is ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep downhill grade is coming. Check your brakes.

questions.question: This sign shows one type of:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that your road ends at an intersection ahead. Slow down and be ready to yield or stop before turning right or left.

questions.question: What does this yellow sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic may be merging onto the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this black and yellow sign mean?

options.text: The road to the right is one-way only.
There is a detour to the right due to road construction.
The road ahead turns at a sharp angle.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns at a sharp angle.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They warn you about conditions ahead. This sign tells you to slow down and prepare for a sharp turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for people with disabilities.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes of traffic going the same way will soon merge into one lane.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You cannot turn on a red light.

questions.correctAnswerText: You cannot turn on a red light.
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs tell you about traffic laws you must follow. This sign at an intersection means you cannot turn right or left when the light is red.

questions.question: What does this sign indicate?

options.text: The height from the road to a bridge or overpass.
The maximum legal height of a vehicle in this state.
The maximum width of a vehicle on the highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: The height from the road to a bridge or overpass.
questions.explanation: This is a low clearance warning sign. It tells you the distance from the road surface to the bottom of a bridge or overpass. In this case, it is 12 feet, 6 inches.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for people with disabilities.

questions.explanation: This sign is posted on one-way streets and other roads where you cannot enter. You may see this sign if you try to go the wrong way on an expressway ramp.

questions.question: If you want to turn left at an intersection with this signal, what should you do?

options.text: Turn if you yield to other drivers.
Stop completely and turn when it is safe.
Stop completely and wait until the red arrow turns off.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and wait until the red arrow turns off.
questions.explanation: When a red left arrow appears at an intersection, you must stop before the intersection or crosswalk. Stay stopped until the red arrow is gone.

questions.question: What does this white sign mean?

options.text: You should slow down and move to the right lane.
Stay in the right lane if you are driving slower than other traffic.
Slower traffic must exit to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay in the right lane if you are driving slower than other traffic.
questions.explanation: A white rectangular sign tells you to obey important traffic rules. This sign means drivers should keep the left lane open for passing and faster traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that the divided highway ends ahead. Be ready to change lanes.
